title: Town and Country Sermons

He cautions against ritualistic worship that lacks genuine intention and encourages active engagement in good deeds as the highest form of faith. The sermon serves as both a philosophical reflection and a moral guide, urging the readers to consider their intentions in worship and encourage a lifestyle reflecting Christ's values in their everyday roles and responsibilities.
